name: riveteers confluence
mana cost: {2}{B}{R}{G}
types: sorcery
spell[1]: choose three
option[2]: you draw a card and you lose 1 life.
option[3]: CARDNAME deals 1 damage to each creature and planeswalker you don't control.
option[4]: you may put a land card from your hand or graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
